verification.source_review: Reviewed scoped source changes and publication inventory. React renders names, notes, tags and errors as text. Tags remain main-process validated. No SQL, shell/template/HTML execution or new privileged IPC introduced. Fingerprint generation and overrides removed; other privileged modules follow 0.1.5. Sender and main-frame checks, sandboxing, permission denial, encrypted credentials, HTTP(S) validation and no-direct-fallback remain intact.
verification.instructions_review: Changed specs/plans/docs contain task scope and no exfiltration or policy-changing instructions.
verification.publication_inventory: Source, synthetic tests, documentation and screenshots of fictional data only. Browser partitions, real profile metadata, credentials and backups excluded.
verification.installer_manifest: Version, byte length, SHA512 verified against tested 2.0.0 installer; SHA256SUMS refreshed.
verification.tests: Fresh release-time run: 25 unit and 24 Electron tests passed. 11 packaged regressions passed on the same installer payload.

limitations: Source review and targeted pattern scanning do not guarantee absence of vulnerabilities. Unsigned binaries retain the existing release trust model.
